reconciliationLimits: The diagnostic has 16 provider-reported discovery candidates, 14 normalized source-state records, and 16 candidate-lineage records. The normalized records include repeated entries for the same resolved URL and physical-open index; the lineage also includes official-source-discovery records. Counts and ordering therefore do not support a one-to-one mapping from discovery candidates to lineage rows.
No original discovery rank is present in the persisted candidate snapshots. The source report's array order and this ledger's row numbers are not represented as discovery order.

For Google-grounded citations, the stored URL/resolved URL is often only an opaque Google redirect. The final target is unavailable for unopened citations. Redirect tokens are deliberately redacted here.

The narrative preserves full receipt details for physical opens 2, 6, and 7. Open 8 has only a sparse official-discovery lineage record. The original report explicitly says source/receipt details for opens 1, 3, 4, and 5 were not preserved.

Candidate titles and search-domain labels are not source validation. No snippet is preserved for the Google candidates, and exactProject is false / sourceType is null in normalized candidate records. Do not infer eligibility from later accessibility or extracted text.

currentAdmissionCodeRead.scopeNote: Working-tree implementation only; the original canary report identifies a different source revision, so this is not proof of the exact live-source implementation.
currentAdmissionCodeRead.observation: The grounded prefetch path iterates the supplied candidate array and asks the physical-open scheduler for authorization; the opened-document rank is assigned from array index. No exact-project/content ranking is applied in that prefetch loop. The separate prioritizeResearchSources helper sorts sources later and does not itself select documents for opening.
currentAdmissionCodeRead.implication: The persisted canary supports an upstream open-order concern: known pre-open labels include generic roots/social/video/local domains, while exact DFW10/DFW14 identities are visible only in the post-open TDLR passages. Missing receipt data prevents a complete reconstruction of all eight slots or proof that every potentially exact source was missed.

scopeBoundary: This report is offline diagnosis only. It does not change ranking, document access, evidence eligibility, prompts, security controls, or provider behavior. No live or network retrieval was performed.
